launchSubtitle: Permissionless. Costs gas only — there is no launch fee.
tokensSubtitle: Every token launched here, newest first.

form.name: Name
form.metadataURIHelp: Image, description and links. Emitted for indexers and not stored on-chain, so it cannot be changed after launch.
form.pairedWithHelp: What your token trades against. Buyers and sellers pay in it, and your trade fees arrive in it. It cannot change after launch.
form.valuationHelp: Fully diluted valuation: the starting price × all {{supply}} tokens.
form.tradeFeeHelp: Charged on every buy and sell, always in {{quote}}. {{share}}% goes to you, {{platform}}% to SecondOrder. Up to {{max}}%, fixed at launch.
form.firstBuyHelp: Optional. Bought for you in the launch transaction, right after the pool opens and before anyone else can trade — at the opening price and the same trade fee as everyone.

summary.title: What this creates
summary.snipeTax: Early buys: a snipe tax starting at {{start}}%, falling to your trade fee over {{duration}}. Your first buy is exempt.
summary.allocationNote: The entire supply goes into the pool. If you want a position, make a first buy: same price and fee as anyone, just first in line.
summary.liquidityValue: Locked for good, at every price
summary.liquidityNote: The whole supply goes into one Uniswap v4 position that nobody can withdraw. It runs from your starting price to the end of the price scale, so the token never sells out. No bonding curve, no graduation.

errors.fdvTooLow: Minimum is {{min}} {{quote}}. Below that, a single ordinary buy consumes most of the pool.
errors.tradeFeeInvalid: Enter a trade fee in percent, such as 1
errors.firstBuyInvalid: Enter an amount in {{quote}}, or leave it empty
errors.firstBuyNoRouter: In-app trading is switched off right now, so a first buy cannot be made. Leave it empty to launch without one.
errors.firstBuyBalance: Not enough {{quote}} for this first buy

unavailable.title: No launchpad on this network
unavailable.body: The launchpad is not deployed here. Switch networks, or deploy it — see the contracts deploy steps 20-22.
unavailable.notReadyBody: No liquidity placer is configured, so launches would revert. This chain may not have a Uniswap v4 deployment yet.

detail.notFoundBody: This address was not launched here. Only tokens from the launchpad appear on these pages.
detail.soldNote: Liquidity at every price — it never sells out
detail.factLiquidityValue: Whole supply · locked at every price
detail.factTradeFeeValue: {{fee}}% of every buy and sell, in {{quote}}
detail.soldLabel: of supply sold into the market

success.title: Launched
success.body: Your token is live and tradeable.

hero.title: Launch a token.
hero.body: The whole supply goes into a Uniswap v4 pool the moment it launches — no bonding curve, no graduation, no dev allocation.

trade.title: Trade {{symbol}}
trade.snipeTax: Launch snipe tax: {{rate}}% now, falling to {{fee}}% in {{time}}
trade.exceedsBuy: This buy would run past the end of the pool’s price range, so it cannot fill. Try a smaller amount.
trade.exceedsBuyPartial: This buy would run past the end of the pool’s price range — only part of it can fill.
trade.exceedsSell: This sale would push the price back past launch — only part of it can fill.
trade.routerOffBody: The pool is live and quotes are current, but trading from this page is switched off right now.

raffle.unavailable: Raffle details are unavailable right now.
raffle.priceRises: Ticket price rises as tickets sell
raffle.upcomingBody: Tickets start at {{price}} {{symbol}} and rise as they sell. The prize pool grows with every ticket.
raffle.upcomingBodyNoPrice: Tickets rise in price as they sell. The prize pool grows with every ticket.
raffle.drawingBody_one: Entries closed with {{count}} player. The winner is being drawn on-chain by Chainlink VRF — nobody, including us, can pick it.
raffle.drawingBody_other: Entries closed with {{count}} players. The winner is being drawn on-chain by Chainlink VRF — nobody, including us, can pick it.
raffle.endedBody: {{season}} is settled. Any holder with enough staked {{symbol}} can open the next season.
raffle.noneBody: Tickets would be priced in {{symbol}}. Any holder with enough stake can open the first season.

creatorFees.pendingQuote: Includes {{amount}} {{quote}} not yet collected — claiming collects it first.

creatorFees.emptyBody: No fees yet. You earn {{share}}% of the {{fee}}% trade fee on every {{name}} buy and sell, paid in {{quote}}.

transferDialog.title: Transfer {{name}} fees
transferDialog.body: Future fees go to the new address. What you've already earned stays yours to claim. Only the new recipient can transfer it again.
transferDialog.label: New recipient

errors.invalid: Enter a valid address (0x followed by 40 hex characters).
errors.zero: Fees can't go to the zero address.
errors.same: This address already receives these fees.

profile.title: Creator fees
profile.subtitle: Fees are paid in each launch's quote currency and claim together across your launches — ETH with ETH, USDC with USDC.
profile.footnote: Totals include fees not yet collected from each launch. A claim collects them first, in the same transaction. Collected fees are pooled per currency across launches, so they show only in the totals.
